contents.Text: Open these settings by clicking the gear icon in the Music Player.
Automatic Gain Control (AGC) dynamically modifies audio volume, enhancing or reducing it in real-time, based on the current loudness of the music to maintain optimal listening levels.
Enables the speed control UI, allowing you to adjust the playback speed of the music.
Once enabled, the [[[strong:Speed Slider]]] is shown in the Music Player, next to the volume slider.
